dedupe_keys.name: infdb energy and infrastructure data services

description: InfDB is an open-source set of data services for energy and infrastructure modelling. Its repository describes a containerized installation with APIs and standard interfaces for geospatial and time-series inputs. A modeller can configure the services for a chosen region and study period; the project is software infrastructure, not a published national energy dataset. The public repository states Apache-2.0. It can help teams keep electricity-system input data and model results organized across planning scenarios. A caveat is that the database services do not make an external dataset accurate, licensed for reuse or compatible with a particular model. Users must still document provenance, units and access rights for data they load. No matching catalogue or first-review resource was found. The JOSS page, own repository and documentation were checked without installing containers or loading a dataset.
name: InfDB energy and infrastructure data services
